title: NASA GeneLab Data Processing RNA-Seq Pipeline pipeline parameters
description: RNA-Seq Pipeline for Documents GL-DPPD-7101-G and GL-DPPD-7115.

outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved. You have to use absolute paths to storage on Cloud infrastructure.

validate_params.description: Boolean whether to validate parameters against the schema at runtime

multiqc_config.description: Path to the MultiQC config file.

rseqc_sample_count.description: Number of read-pairs used for RSeQC infer_experiment.py and inner_distance.py

pbs_queue.description: PBS Pro queue. Used with `-profile pbspro`.

pbs_model.description: PBS model resource in clusterOptions. Empty omits :model=.

pbs_internet_queue.description: PBS queue for fetch/download processes. Empty uses --pbs_queue.

derived_store_path.description: Location where the derived reference files will be stored.

reference_store_path.description: Location where the reference fasta and gtf will be stored.

accession.description: Input OSD or GLDS identifier as 'OSD-#' or 'GLDS-#' if processing an OSDR dataset.

isa_archive_path.description: Path to the ISA.zip for an OSDR dataset. '--accession' must also be used.

mode.description: Specifies whether to use the default Eukaryotes workflow or the Prokaryotes workflow with ' --mode microbes'.

assay_suffix.description: Specifies a string that should be used to label the output file names.

stage_only.description: Publish the runsheet and staged inputs for the current entry point, then exit. truncate_to applies to raw and trimmed reads.

post_processing.description: Update the assay table and generate md5sums for ${outdir}/${accession}.

strandedness.description: auto = infer strandedness from RSeQC infer_experiment. none/forward/reverse overrides RSeQC output. Required, no auto for params.entry_point=bam_files.

counts_table_path.description: Path to counts table file. Used with `counts_table` entry point.

dge_table_path.description: Path to DGE table file. Used with `dge_table` entry point.

references.title: References
references.description: By default, reference_table points to GeneLab Reference Annotations Table GL-DPPD-7110-A_annotations.csv which defines reference FASTA and GTF files and associated GeneLab-generated gene annotations.

reference_fasta.description: Specifies an alternative reference FASTA file to use in place of the one listed in GL-DPPD-7110-A_annotations.csv.

reference_gtf.description: Specifies an alternative reference GTF file to use in place of the one listed in GL-DPPD-7110-A_annotations.csv.

reference_source.description: Specifies the source of the alternative reference files. (e.g. "ncbi" or "ensembl").

reference_version.description: Specifies the version of the alternative reference files used, if available.

gene_annotations_file.description: Local path or URL of a gene annotations TSV. Overrides the file listed in GL-DPPD-7110-A_annotations.csv. Figshare ndownloader links are rewritten to the API.

dge_filtering.title: DGE Filtering Parameters
dge_filtering.description: Control how raw count genes are filtered prior to differential expression analysis

dge_filter_method.description: Method for filtering genes based on raw counts prior to differential expression analysis

dge_filter_sum_threshold.description: Minimum total count sum across all samples

dge_filter_sample_percent_threshold.description: Remove genes if this percentage or more of their total counts come from the highest-count samples

dge_filter_sample_percent_max_samples.description: Number of highest-count samples to check gene counts from

dge_filter_min_samples_threshold.description: Minimum samples where gene must be expressed

debugging_options.title: Debugging options
debugging_options.description: Parameters used to reduce the size of inputs or reference data

limit_samples_to.description: Only use the first n samples for the analysis

genome_subsample.description: Subsample the reference genome to the specified region / chromosome.

force_single_end.description: Only use Read 1 for each sample, even if the original data is paired-end.

truncate_to.description: Only use the specified number of reads from each input file.

use_dummy_gene_counts.description: Generate random gene counts during DGE. This is should be enabled when using '--truncate_to'.
